method: Read all four original and candidate independent English essays, all 254 candidate Chinese source units, and final local differences. Re-read final English decks and local corrections after source freeze. English remains independent prose, not a forced paragraph-aligned translation.
changes: Removed stale article metadata that repeated disproven all-concentric heating and direct child-labour discontent claims.
Limited captain-without-a-body description to ordinary management, rather than all possible cinematic scenes.
Corrected retrospective transition to the Purpose fork and narrowed unverified Winterhome comparative details.
Removed algorithm-audit wording from the essay in favor of a natural focus on two terminal-law examples.
findings: All 83 original English units retained in order with local corrections.
Child shelter and apprenticeship distinguished; management perspective is a tendency, not impossibility of individual help.
Propaganda Centre graffiti event corrected using the actual game panel; removal effect is shown, punishment effect not invented.
Final-law violent events acknowledged; Hope replacement distinguished from disappearance of Discontent.
Winterhome cannot save its city but retains law tools and limited evacuation choices; no claim that those tools solve allocation or guarantee survival.
Moral-boundary argument identified as a reading, not an exhaustively certified flag algorithm.
limits: Direct screenshots and selected public video storyboard frames were actually inspected; no fresh complete gameplay or continuous full video/audio viewing.
Exhaustive ending flags were not obtained from original code or developer documentation.
Original game only; no sequel, board game or remake mechanics imported.
